title: Spur Enrichment
description: Enrich IPv4 and IPv6 observables on demand with the Spur Context API. Each enrichment adds Spur labels (tunnels, risks, services, infrastructure, client behaviors, AI activity) and a score to the IP, links it to its autonomous system and locations, creates an anonymization Infrastructure per VPN or proxy operator, and attaches a note with the client context.
short_description: Enrich IP addresses with Spur Context API intelligence: VPN, proxy and anonymization services, risks, autonomous system, location and client behaviors.
